metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of lower back pain with an easy step-by-step guide.

This video will show the best method towards healing a lower back injury, including what to do first and what exercises (and stretches) are the most effective. 

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give lower back pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix your low back pain!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:46 Muscle Warm Up
4:34 Strengthening Exercise 1
7:37 Strengthening Exercise 2
9:12 Back Stretch
11:27 Core Stretch
12:11 Side Stretch
